paraphrase: A hymn to Tirumāl: all the elements, the gods, the Vedas and the sacrifices are he; he is the one who takes the forms of the boar, the man-lion and the others.
notes: Content recalled generally for the Tirumāl hymns of the Paripāṭal (hymns 1–4 and others); poem number low confidence. Parimēlaḻakar is the commentator, not the poet.
